events.provenance: Mobile Press photograph/caption published July 8, 1959 and preserved by the Alabama Department of Archives and History. Archive metadata dates the event July 7, 1959; the caption calls it one of the largest jubilees and says the Grafs lived about four miles south of the Grand Hotel.
events.notes: High-value exact archival positive. Catch size measures harvest, not the event's full spatial boundary.

events.provenance: Mobile Register photo/caption published Aug. 16, 1972 and preserved by Alabama Department of Archives and History. Caption says the Jubilee was early Tuesday morning; Aug. 15, 1972 was Tuesday.
events.notes: Exact day is a transparent calendar inference from the contemporaneous caption; preserve date_precision in any model join.

events.notes: Same-day first-person account relayed by the hosting blog; preserve as one independence group.
